enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Incandescence: This weapon glows with the light of Irian. This weapon deals an extra 1 to 6 points of light damage on a successful hit.

Ooze Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Oozes, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +2 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against the foe.

Aberration Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Aberrations, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +2 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against the foe.

Magical Beast Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Magical Beasts, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +2 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against the foe.

Acidic Reaping: While this item is equipped, any killing blows you strike against enemies grants you 40 Acid resistance for 30 seconds. Slaying weaker opponents has a reduced chance of producing this effect.
